component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Data normalization metanode using nonlinear normalization techniques.
Currently implements quantile, vsn and loess (with 3 different methods) techniques. Consult e.g. limma R package for details on each normalization technique.
You can select what columns should be processed by the metanode, no need to preselect them before the node.
The node returns only selected columns after applied normalization with the same table header.
